Data.String: liquid NH3 from storage via P-01
TZ-605 stops the SCR ammonia below the R-102 inlet temperature limit (ammonium nitrate deposits, NH3 slip): C&E I-601. FIC-603 set from AI-614 by the operator (D-019)
PIC-611 holds the absorber pressure at the X-101 inlet; US-612 (train trip, C&E I-602) closes XV-610; start-up runs through X-101 (SEQ-START-BURNER S1), no bypass yet (D-021)
AI-614 (NOx), AI-615 (N2O): stack emission monitoring. R-102 protected by PSV-404 (P-04); E-108 by PSV-616 (D-021). K-101, K-102 and X-101 form one machine train with the electric motor (D-011)
